title: Cowboys DC Christian Parker: Mike Pettine a "right-hand man" not a "save the day" hire

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cowboys DC Christian Parker: Mike Pettine a "right-hand man" not a "save the day" hire
sources.description: The Cowboys hired longtime NFL defensive coordinator and former Browns head coach Mike Pettine as a senior defensive assistant this week and defensive coordinator Christian Parker was asked at a Thursday press conference if Pettine is a "save the day" hire after a rough start.
